Now the Route Handlers. The original `pages/api/posts/index.js` handled GET (list) and POST (create with validation). The original `pages/api/posts/[id].js` handled GET, PUT, DELETE with `req.query.id`, `req.body`, and `res.status().json()` / `res.setHeader('Allow', ...).status(405).end()`. 

In App Router Route Handlers: named exports per method (`GET`, `POST`, etc.), `params` is a Promise, body via `await request.json()`, responses via `Response.json()` / `new Response()`. For 405 method-not-allowed, I'll return a 405 with an `Allow` header.

The original API routes returned a 405 for unsupported methods. In App Router, if a method isn't exported, Next.js auto-implements `OPTIONS` and returns 405 for the unsupported methods with the `Allow` header — so I don't need explicit 405 handling. | Pages Router | App Router | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `pages/_app.js` + `pages/_document.js` | `app/layout.tsx` | Root layout with `<html>`/`<body>`, `AppProvider`, nav/footer, global CSS import, `next/font/google` (Inter) replacing the Google Fonts `<link>`, and `Metadata` API replacing `<meta>` tags |
| `pages/index.js` (`getServerSideProps`) | `app/page.tsx` | Async Server Component; `req.headers['user-agent']` → `headers()`; `getServerSideProps` → `fetch(..., { cache: 'no-store' })`; `next/head` → `export const metadata`; `useRouter().push` → client `home-actions.tsx` |
| `pages/blog/index.js` (`getStaticProps` + `revalidate: 60`) | `app/blog/page.tsx` | `export const revalidate = 60`; `<a href>` → `next/link`; `useRouter().push` → client `post-card-actions.tsx` |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` (`getStaticPaths` + `getStaticProps`) | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` | `getStaticPaths` → `generateStaticParams`; `fallback: 'blocking'` → default `dynamicParams: true`; `revalidate: 300` → `next: { revalidate: 300 }`; `notFound` on error; `router.isFallback` → `loading.tsx`; `router.back()` → client `back-button.tsx`; `next/head` → `generateMetadata` |
| `pages/404.js` | `app/not-found.tsx` | `useRouter().push` → client `go-home-button.tsx`; `next/head` → `export const metadata` |
| `pages/_error.js` (`getInitialProps`) | `app/error.tsx` + `app/global-error.tsx` | Client Component error boundaries with the `retry` prop (v16 stable API) |
| `pages/api/posts/index.js` | `app/api/posts/route.ts` | `GET`/`POST` named exports; `req.body` → `await request.json()`; `res.status().json()` → `Response.json(..., { status })` |
| `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` | `req.query.id` → `params` Promise; `GET`/`PUT`/`DELETE` exports; 405 handling auto-implemented by Next.js |

## Key API replacements (per the v16 docs)
- `getServerSideProps` → async Server Component + `fetch({ cache: 'no-store' })`
- `getStaticProps` (+`revalidate`) → `fetch` with `next: { revalidate }` / `export const revalidate`
- `getStaticPaths` → `generateStaticParams`
- `next/head` → Metadata API (`metadata` / `generateMetadata`)
- `next/router` `useRouter` → `next/navigation` `useRouter` (in Client Components)
- `req`/`res` API routes → Web `Request`/`Response` Route Handlers
- `_document` fonts → `next/font/google`
- `router.isFallback` → `loading.tsx`
- All files are TypeScript with explicit types (props, params as `Promise`, response bodies, context).
